grades.quote: When VTSR=1, an attempt in VS-mode to execute SRET raises a virtualinstruction exception.
grades.reason: The passage describes RISC-V H-extension hstatus bits (VTSR, VTW, VTVM) that make certain privileged operations in VS-mode (SRET, WFI, SFENCE.VMA, satp access) raise virtual-instruction exceptions. These exceptions trap to the hypervisor, which is the mechanism behind trap-and-emulate. The passage never explains why the VMM must intercept privileged guest instructions, such as protecting the VMM's control of resources or keeping the guest's view of the machine consistent. It gives only auxiliary, mechanism-level context.
